nativeCapabilities.subagents: custom project agents under .claude/agents with foreground/background execution
nativeCapabilities.agentTeams: experimental shared task list and peer messaging, disabled by default
nativeCapabilities.approvals: permission modes and allow/deny rules; background requests surface to the lead in supported versions
nativeCapabilities.resume: sessions and some subagents can resume; experimental teams have resumption limitations

dispatchGuidance: Use CLAUDE.md as the bridge to the canonical skill; PM and implementer work must still be recorded in the portable run graph.
Use ordinary subagents for focused work that only needs to report to the manager.
Use worktree isolation for parallel writers and keep each worker's file ownership disjoint.
Use command hooks only for deterministic enforcement; do not require platform hooks for the portable core.
If native agents or teams are unavailable, use the rendered prompt in a separate Claude Code session.
limitations: Agent teams are experimental, disabled by default, and have resumption/task-state limitations.
Parallel same-file edits can overwrite one another without worktree/file ownership isolation.
Claude Code project skill discovery is .claude/skills; CLAUDE.md bridges to the canonical .agents skill.
